title: The contact card reads complete in every empty state
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab.
  3. Seed rows (contact details are set on the customer's Contacts tab and the asset's preferred contact):
  4. ↳ A: the preferred contact has a phone but no email, and no other contact of the customer has an email.
  5. ↳ B: the preferred contact has an email but no phone.
  6. ↳ C: the preferred contact has neither, and no other contact has an email.
  7. ↳ D: the preferred contact has neither, but another contact of the customer has an email.
  8. ↳ E: the asset has no preferred contact.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Contact card for row A, then row B.
  2. Open the card for row C, then row D; look for Send reminder on each.
  3. Open the card for row E; use its action to set a preferred contact and save.
  4. In each case judge whether the card reads as complete or as broken.
  5. On each card read the empty-state labels and hover their (i).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A shows its no-email state; B shows its no-phone state.
  • C shows both empty states and no Send reminder; D shows both empty states and does offer Send reminder (another contact has an email).
  • E shows an empty state in place of the contact details with an action to set one, and no send action; after setting a contact the card updates.
  • Every state reads as complete, not broken.
  • On the design: no email reads "No email address" with "Add an address" and the (i) "The phone is the only route until an address is added."; no phone reads "No phone number" with "Add a number" and the (i) "Call is unavailable until one is added. Email is the only route."; no contact reads "No contact information" with "Add contact information".
  • On the design a contact with neither shows "No phone number" with the hover "Nothing to call." and "No email address" with the hover "Nothing to send to."

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10571 (S14, Contact the customer from a row), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S14 (S14-R8, S14-N2, S14-N4, S14-E1); Plan 1 — Track, act, clear — Technical Implementation Plan, section 6 Phase P7, frontend table (ContactCard); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboards B1e, B1p, B1n; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S14-R8: “The card will render a state for a contact with no email, and a state for a contact with no phone number”
  • S14-N2: “A contact with neither email nor phone shows both empty states. There is no send action unless another of the customer's contacts has an email address, per the rule above”
  • S14-N4: “An asset with no preferred contact shows an empty state in place of the contact details, with an action to set one. There is no send action until a contact exists”
  • S14-E1: “The empty states are common rather than exceptional, so the card must read as complete in every one of them”
  • Plan 1 §6 P7 ContactCard: “no-email / no-phone / no-contact states (S14-R8, N2, N4, E1) with "Set contact"”
  • Design board, artboard B1e (no email): “The phone is the only route until an address is added.”
  • Design board, artboard B1p (no phone): “Call is unavailable until one is added. Email is the only route.”
  • Design board, artboard B1p (no contact): “No contact information”
  • Design board, artboard B1p (no contact): “Add contact information”
  • Design board, artboard B1p (no phone, no email): “Nothing to call.”
  • Design board, artboard B1p (no phone, no email): “Nothing to send to.”
